## Change the Music.app Volume with Alfred
The built-in Alfred Mini Player only allows to choose between mute, volume to 50%, or max. the Workflow allows for more choices in case you have superhuman ears like me.
### Change the Volume
0 to 100, `mute`/`m`, `unmute`/`um` or `up`/`u` and `down`/`d` to change the Volume by increments or decrements of 10.
![mv 68](resources/images/mv68.png)
### Query the Volume
You can query the current Volume of the Music.app by passing no parameter.
![mv](resources/images/mv.png)
